verdict.rationale: Pylon's Assist Agent is an interactive teammate that drafts replies for human agents, so a human reviews and sends them, and the customer-facing Support Agent can be scoped to issues you assign it. Neither is documented as a launch mode that holds the Support Agent's outbound replies for human approval. The evidence shows human-in-the-loop drafting and scoped deployment, not a formal approval gate. Missing for 10: an explicit supervised/approval mode for the Support Agent, documentation of a review-and-send workflow for AI drafts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
